SELECT c.name AS customer_name, 
       SUM(s.total_amount) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN sales s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;
